home.title: Magic Solo
home.lead: Three self-running Challenge Decks: Face the Hydra, Battle the Horde, and Defeat a God. Play a full Challenge Experience, or use the Game Assistant with your paper deck.

challenge.setupLead: Muster a force, then fight the self-running Challenge Deck.
challenge.hordeDelay: Your turns before the Horde acts
challenge.noteMuster: Each turn you gain muster to recruit creatures from your chosen force.
challenge.noteCombat: Select attackers, assign targets (or mill the Horde), then end your turn to let the challenge act.
challenge.noteSimplified: Draws become muster; discards become life loss.
challenge.pickDeckHint: Click a force to preview every card, then confirm your pick.
challenge.musterHint: Recruit creatures below to build your army.
challenge.attackerHint: Tap a creature to declare an attacker, then click a target on the challenge side.
challenge.assignHint: Click a Head / Reveler / Xenagos to assign your selected attackers.
challenge.hordeAttackHint: Damage to the Horde mills cards from its library.
challenge.blockHint: Click your creatures to cycle blockers onto attackers, then resolve.

result.godFallen: Xenagos Ascended has fallen. You win!
result.zeroLife: Your life total reached 0. The challenge prevails.
result.noHeads: At end of turn, no Heads remain. Victory!
result.hordeBroken: Library empty and no creatures — you win!

prompt.hordeAttackers: {{n}} Minotaur(s) attack. Assign blockers, then resolve combat.
prompt.hordeAttackersContinue: {{n}} Minotaur(s) attack. Assign blockers, then continue.
prompt.distractHydraMsg: Sacrifice a creature to tap a Head, or lose 3 life.
prompt.impulsiveDestructionMsg: Sacrifice an artifact or enchantment you control? If you have none, take 3 damage.

tip.advance: A challenge card is revealed — click to confirm and continue.
tip.block: Click your creatures to assign blockers, then resolve combat.
tip.muster: Click a card in the roster below to recruit (costs muster).
tip.mainReady: Keep recruiting, or click Enter combat / a creature to attack.
tip.toCombat: Click Enter combat or one of your creatures to start declaring attackers.
tip.declareAttackers: Click a dashed-outline creature to declare an attacker. Click again to cancel.
tip.assignTargets: Click a glowing enemy to assign a target.
tip.attackHorde: Press Attack the Horde to mill its library.
tip.resolveCombat: Press Resolve combat to deal damage.
tip.endTurn: Press End turn to pass to the challenge.
tip.won: Victory! Play again for another run.
tip.lost: Defeat. Play again to try a different approach.

assistant.setupLead: Challenge side online, your deck offline — operate the challenge half-board manually.
assistant.setupBlankHint: Shuffle the full deck into the library; battlefield starts empty.
assistant.setupRulesHint: Place starting permanents by the rules, then shuffle the rest into the library.
assistant.searchHint: Drag to reorder; drag out or click to play onto the battlefield.
assistant.emptyBoard: Drag drawn cards onto a slot, or play from search.
assistant.expandUp: Add a slot above this seat
assistant.expandDown: Add a slot below this seat
assistant.expandLeft: Add a slot to the left of this seat
assistant.expandRight: Add a slot to the right of this seat
assistant.stagingHint: Drag to battlefield, graveyard, or exile
assistant.drawHint: Click to draw · double-click to search
assistant.hintBar: Drag between slots · right-click menu · click library to draw · double-click to search
